name: Mite Pack
desc: Six Mites. Cheap chip damage and the best eco per dollar.

name: Drone Pair Pack
desc: Four Drones. Solid early eco with a little more bite.

name: Runner Squad
desc: Four Runners. Quick pressure that still pays you back.

name: Bolt Trio
desc: Three Bolts. Fast enough to slip past sleepy defenses.

name: Swarm Burst
desc: Eight Swarmlings at full sprint. Punishes thin coverage.

name: Ingot Convoy
desc: Three Ingots. Sharp-only defenses cannot touch them.

name: Leech Cluster
desc: Three Leeches. They heal through weak scattered fire.

name: Aegis Line
desc: Three Aegis. Shields eat single big hits for breakfast.

name: Phantom Cell
desc: Three Phantoms. Invisible to anyone who skipped camo.

name: Husk Drop
desc: Two Husks. Heavy shells that burst into Bolts.

name: Onyx Hammer
desc: Two Onyx. Raw mass, mediocre eco, real pain.

name: Colossus Strike
desc: One Colossus. Costs you eco. Meant to end someone.

name: Unleash The Brood
desc: The Brood itself. A huge eco sacrifice for a finishing blow.
